messages:
Maya Chen: Quick debrief — we ran an A/B on invite copy for the private beta outreach (segments: startups, enterprise). Sharing highlights + asks.

DevRel Bot: Survey summary: 1,248 sends per arm. Open rates: A 48.1% | B 53.9% (+12%). RSVP (booked intro): A 8.6% | B 10.5% (+22%). Quality flagged (internal judge): A 73% usable | B 68% usable.

Liam O'Neill: Nice. Can you post the raw spreadsheet and sample size per segment?

Maya Chen: Posted sheet: https://docs.redwood.ai/sheets/invite-ab-4135

Maya Chen: Raw numbers snippet:
```
segment,startups,enterprise
arm_A_sends,620,628
arm_B_sends,624,624
arm_A_rsvps,61,46
arm_B_rsvps,83,39
```

Sophie Patel: Interesting — B drives higher RSVPs overall but the lift is concentrated in startups. Enterprise looks noisy. My read: use B for startups and keep A for enterprise unless we tone down B's "exclusive hype" phrasing.

Alex P: Quick Q on cadence — did we test 24h follow-up vs 72h? I remember a follow-up template (short tech-first) that underperformed.

DevRel Bot: Follow-up breakdown: 24h follow-up +3% absolute RSVP, 72h follow-up +1% absolute. Template 2 (short tech-first) underperformed vs our more consultative follow-up.

Morgan (product): Rec: adopt B for startups, keep A for enterprise but tweak the enterprise subject to be more use-case focused. Add a 24h follow-up with a consultative body for enterprise.

Maya Chen: Ask: volunteers to implement the copy changes + update outreach sequences? Goal: freeze templates by Thu (3 days).

Liam O'Neill: I can update the outreach templates today and push to the Outreach repo. Tag me for wording edits.

Sophie Patel: I'll draft a toned-down B variant for enterprise and drop it in the sheet. Also propose adding one triage question to the signup form: "primary use case (brief)".

Alex P: +1 on the triage question — helps DP prioritization and routing.

Maya Chen: Plan recap: (1) Liam updates templates (owner: Liam) (2) Sophie adds toned B for enterprise (owner: Sophie) (3) add triage question in form (owner: Alex) (4) freeze by Thu. Who owns follow-ups?

Alex P: I'll own follow-ups and rollout logic. Will check current automation for conflicts.

Maya Chen: Perfect — I'll open a final commit PR and a 1-pager for ops to reference. Thanks all :rocket:
